targets.old_statement: Vehicles carrying passengers for hire, all school buses and vehicles hauling explosives or flammable liquids must always stop between 15 and 50 feet from the nearest rail at a railroad crossing.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Vehicles carrying passengers for hire, all school buses and vehicles hauling explosives or flammable liquids must always stop between fifteen and fifty feet from the nearest rail at a railroad crossing.
targets.statement: Passenger-for-hire vehicles, all school buses, and vehicles transporting explosives or flammable liquids must stop fifteen to fifty feet from the nearest rail at railroad crossings, except at signed abandoned tracks or crossings where the rails have been removed.
